item.title: 'The best gift ever': Baby is born after the rarest of pregnancies, defying all odds
item.description: Doctors say just 1 in 30,000 pregnancies occur in the abdomen instead of the uterus. And Ryu Lopez is among the rare cases. He developed outside his mom's womb, hidden by a basketball-sized ovarian cyst.

item.title: Florida woman wins $1M on scratch-off ticket purchased at Publix
